table_id.description: Unique ID of the drop table, derived from the OSRS Wiki page name.

label.description: The wiki drop-version or heading this table came from (e.g. 'Drops', 'Wilderness Slayer Cave').

table_name.description: Display name of the drop table, combining the wiki page and the label.

wiki_page.description: The OSRS Wiki page the drop table was parsed from.

main_max_roll.description: Size of the main table pool, out of which each weighted entry is rolled.

entries.description: Array of guaranteed, main table, pre-roll, separate roll and shared table drops.

item_id.description: Unique OSRS item ID of the drop.

name.description: The name of the drop, as written on the wiki.

quantity.description: The quantity dropped, as a [minimum, maximum] pair.

quantity_raw.description: The raw wiki quantity, when it is not a plain number or range.

always.description: If the drop is guaranteed on every kill.

pre_roll.description: If the drop is rolled before the main table.

separate_roll.description: If the drop is rolled independently of the main table pool.

nothing.description: If the entry is an empty slot in the main table pool.

shared_table.description: Name of the shared table rolled by this entry, as keyed in subtables.json.

weight.description: How many of the out_of slots this entry occupies.

out_of.description: The denominator this entry is rolled against.

rarity.description: Chance of a single roll landing on this entry (as a float out of 1.0).

rarity_raw.description: The raw wiki rarity, when it could not be resolved to a numeric rate.

assumed_rarity.description: If the rate is a convention for a word rarity ('Common', 'Rare') rather than wiki data.

clue_scroll_box.description: If the drop arrives as a clue scroll box.

section.description: The wiki subsection the drop was listed under.

notes.description: Wiki footnotes attached to the drop, such as quest or area requirements.

tertiary.description: Array of tertiary drops, rolled independently of the main table.

brimstone_key_roll.description: If the table rolls a brimstone key at the combat level scaled rate.

brimstone_konar_bonus.description: If the brimstone key rate is improved on a Konar slayer task.

unresolved_items.description: Drop names on this table that matched no item in the item database.
